name: stark-clip-ai
description: STARK CLIP AI — estúdio autônomo de cortes (motor Python + HUD Next.js)

scripts.setup: cd services/engine && uv sync && cd ../../apps/web && pnpm install
scripts.dev:api: cd services/engine && uv run uvicorn stark_engine.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --reload --reload-dir stark_engine
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/engine && uv run python -m stark_engine.worker
scripts.check: cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && pnpm build
scripts.lint: cd apps/web && pnpm lint && cd ../../services/engine && uv run ruff check stark_engine
